provenance.instrument: Limerick Township Code Chapter 184 Zoning (Ord. No. 146, 9-29-1992, readopted 10-26-2006 by Ord. No. 269, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 code date 2026-03-03 (breadcrumb). New Laws on the chapter page on 2026-11-14: Ord. No. 438, adopted 2026-07-07, 'Zoning Amendment', Ch 184, PDF only, not opened and not yet in the online text. 184-71 was last amended 6-3-2025 by Ord. No. 434.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 breadcrumb 'Code 2026-03-03'. Ord. No. 438 (2026-07-07, zoning) is listed under New Laws and not yet codified.
provenance.code_caution: A zoning amendment, Ord. No. 438, was adopted on 2026-07-07 and is not yet in the online code. It was not read, so it may change these rules. Ask the Township.
checks: A 'temporary unit for relative' is a permitted accessory use to a single-family dwelling wherever the district allows accessory uses under 184-71: R-1, R-2, R-3, R-4, R-5 and individual lots in MHP (184-71B(6), 184-98C, 184-104C, 184-108E, 184-112F, 184-117E, 184-122)
The unit must be totally enclosed within the house, with an internal connection and access through the main unit. Detached temporary dwellings are prohibited (184-71B(6)(a), (c), (i), (j))

The house must be owner-occupied, and the unit is only for the owner's immediate family: parents, grandparents, children, grandchildren, sisters, brothers, aunts, uncles, stepparents and stepchildren (184-71B(6)(b), (h))

The owners record a covenant, approved by the Township Solicitor, that bars use as two or more dwelling units and requires removing one kitchen within six months after family use ends. The permit is renewed every year (184-71B(6)(d), (e))
With an on-lot septic system, the County Health Department must find it adequate for the added use (184-71B(6)(f))
An addition for the unit must keep the look of a single-family detached house from the street and neighbors (184-71B(6)(g))

A single-family detached house may be converted into a dwelling for more families by special exception: each unit at least 500 sq ft, the lot area per unit not below the district requirement, no outside change except for safety (184-70)
R-4 and R-5 lot and yard figures are in PDF attachments that were not read. Tracts under 10 acres there follow the R-3 rules (184-114A, 184-119A)

VC permits a single-family detached village house, but its use list does not refer to the 184-71 accessory uses, and a lot without public water or sewer may hold only one dwelling unit (184-129R, 184-131). Ask the Zoning Officer whether the unit is allowed there
HC permits one residential use per lot, either one apartment or one single-family detached unit, so a second unit is not permitted there (184-139A(16))

In VC a twin or duplex is permitted (5,000 sq ft per unit with public sewer and water), and an existing single-family house may be converted to at most four apartments with 2,000 sq ft of lot per unit, keeping the front facade (184-129S, V, 184-133A)
Parking: 2 spaces per dwelling unit for a single-family dwelling. Other dwellings: 1 per studio unit, 2 per other unit (184-87)
On lots under 3 acres no accessory building in the front yard or between the house and the street (184-71C(1))
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Limerick Township (limerickpa.org). Read on eCode360 (LI1176) in a browser, one print view at a time, on 2026-11-14. Use lists read for R-1, R-2, R-3, R-4 and R-5. A code search for '184-71' with 'single-family' also returned the MHP sections (snippets only). The VC and HC use lists were read. The MS, O/LI, LLI, HI, HI/E and RB use lists were not read. The R-4 and R-5 development standards (Attachments 1 and 2) are PDF only and were not opened. Parking (184-87) was read.

term.note: 'A temporary dwelling unit may be established as accessory to a principal single-family dwelling unit'.

status.note: A permitted accessory use, inside the house, for immediate family of the owner.

status_outside.note: Outside the districts that allow a single-family dwelling with 184-71 accessory uses the code has no rule for the unit. HC allows one residential use per lot.

status_by_form.note: 'Detached temporary dwellings are specifically prohibited.' The unit is 'totally enclosed within the principal building'.

value.use: single-family detached dwelling with accessory uses under 184-71

scope_by_use.note: 184-71 names no district. The rule reaches a principal single-family dwelling where the district permits it with accessory uses under 184-71. MHP from search snippets only. HC allows one residential use per lot (184-139A(16)). VC permits a village house (184-129R) but its use list does not name the 184-71 accessory uses, so it is left out of both lists and reads as ask.

path.note: 'The following accessory uses shall be permitted, subject to the additional requirements herein.' A permit renewed every year (184-71B(6)(e)).

fallback_path.note: A unit that does not meet 184-71B(6) needs a variance from the Zoning Hearing Board.

value.name: Residential conversion
value.conditions: Conversion of a single-family detached dwelling into a dwelling for more families. Each unit at least 500 sq ft. The lot area per unit may not drop below the district requirement, and yards and building area may not be reduced. No outside change except for safety. The Zoning Hearing Board sets the number of families.
value.note: Read as twice the district lot area for two units (R-1 80,000, R-2 and R-3 traditional lots with public sewer and water 40,000 and 20,000). Not tied to a district list.

value.name: Two-family dwelling (twin or duplex)
value.conditions: Twin or duplex with public sewer and water: 5,000 sq ft per unit, so 10,000 for two, width 60 ft for a duplex, building coverage 20%.
value.note: Read as a path for converting an existing house into two units.

value.name: Multifamily conversion
value.conditions: An existing single-family detached house may be converted to at most four apartments. The front facade and porch are kept, additions go to the rear, stairs and fire escapes to the rear or side. 2,000 sq ft of lot per dwelling unit.

value.name: Two-family dwelling (twin or duplex)
value.conditions: Two-family dwellings are permitted uses. Development under R-4 or R-5 standards needs a 10-acre tract with public sewer and water. Smaller tracts follow R-3, where twins and duplexes also need a 10-acre tract.
value.note: The R-4 and R-5 lot figures are in PDF attachments that were not read.

building_types.note: Accessory to a principal single-family dwelling unit, which must keep its appearance as a single-family detached dwelling.

existing_structure_only.note: Inside the house. An addition is contemplated in (g).

value.condition: Occupied by immediate family of the owner: parents, grandparents, children, grandchildren, sisters, brothers, aunts, uncles, stepparents and stepchildren.
The principal dwelling unit shall be owner-occupied.

Totally enclosed within the principal building, with an internal connection such as a stairway or corridor, and access through the principal unit. An addition keeps the look of a single-family detached house.

Recorded covenant, approved by the Township Solicitor, barring use as two or more dwelling units and requiring removal of one kitchen within six months after family use ends. Permit renewed every year with inspection on request.
An on-lot septic system must be found adequate by the County Health Department for the expanded use.

types_allowed.note: Inside the house, or in an addition that becomes part of the house. Detached units are prohibited.

min_sqft.note: No minimum for the unit was seen.

internal_uses_district_height.note: 35 ft in R-1, R-2 and R-3.

occupancy.value: Immediate family of the owner: parents, grandparents, children, grandchildren, sisters, brothers, aunts, uncles, stepparents and stepchildren.

max_adus.note: 'A temporary dwelling unit'. The covenant bars use as two or more dwelling units.

spaces_required.note: No row for the unit. 'Single-family dwelling: 2 per dwelling unit.' 'Other dwellings not listed separately: 1 per studio unit; 2 per unit for any other unit.'

reading.value: Two spaces for the house. The unit may add 2 more (or 1 for a studio) if it is counted as a dwelling unit. The covenant treats the property as one dwelling, so the Zoning Officer may count only the house.

new_connection_required.note: Septic adequacy only. No rule on a separate connection.

min_lot_sqft.note: Traditional lotting. Cluster and lot averaging lots 40,000.

max_building_coverage.note: Building coverage of the individual lot.

min_lot_sqft.note: Traditional lotting with public sewer and public water. Lot averaging 15,000 (average 35,000), cluster 25,000.

value.when: Public sewer or public water, not both
Public sewer or public water, not both
On-site water and on-site sewage: R-1 rules

min_lot_sqft.note: Traditional lotting with public sewer and public water. Cluster and lot averaging 15,000.

value.when: Public sewer or public water, not both
Public sewer or public water, not both
On-site water and on-site sewage: R-1 rules

min_lot_sqft.note: The R-4 development standards are in a PDF attachment that was not read. Tracts under 10 acres follow R-3 rules.
The R-5 development standards are in a PDF attachment that was not read. Tracts under 10 acres follow R-3 rules.
Single-family detached village house with public sewer and water. Without them, each existing lot may hold one permitted use and one dwelling unit (184-131).

max_building_coverage.note: Of net lot area. Impervious 70%. Bonus to 30% and 75% under 184-136A.
